fields.instruction_en: Enter full name as in pension payment order (PPO). CPAO handles pension payment for central government civil pensioners through authorized banks.
fields.instruction_hi: Pension Payment Order (PPO) mein darz poora naam likhein. CPAO authorized banks ke zariye kendriya sarkari civil pensioners ko pension bhugtaan karta hai.

fields.instruction_en: Enter your Pension Payment Order (PPO) number. This unique number identifies your pension account and is required for any pension-related transaction.
fields.instruction_hi: Apna Pension Payment Order (PPO) number likhein. Yeh unique number aapka pension account pehchaanta hai aur kisi bhi pension-sambandhi lenden ke liye zaruri hai.

fields.instruction_en: Enter the bank account number where pension is to be credited. This must be a savings account in an authorized bank branch.
fields.instruction_hi: Bank khata number likhein jahan pension credit hogi. Yeh authorized bank ki savings account honi chahiye.

fields.instruction_en: Enter the IFSC code of your pension disbursing bank branch.
fields.instruction_hi: Pension vितरण karne wali bank shaakha ka IFSC code likhein.

fields.instruction_en: Enter 12-digit Aadhaar for Jeevan Pramaan (Digital Life Certificate) which pensioners must submit annually to continue receiving pension.
fields.instruction_hi: Jeevan Pramaan (Digital Life Certificate) ke liye 12 ank ka Aadhaar likhein jो pensioners ko pension jaari rakhne ke liye saalana jama karna hota hai.
